1. PORTAL PLACEMENT
Top-level or Finance sub-nav: Net Worth. Company users: entity + consolidated only. Visionary: toggle Company | Personal | Side-by-side (explicit, not one blended total unless user opts in).
Routes: /finance/net-worth | /personal/net-worth | optional /visionary/net-worth (both books labeled).
2. DEFINITION
Net Worth = Total Assets − Total Liabilities. Multiple asset categories required (see §5–§6). Always show category breakdown, not a single opaque number.
Cash is shown as an asset subtotal. Liabilities enter NW only as aggregate totals from GL (including credit card liability balances if any)—no card list, utilization, or credit UI on Net Worth.

4. COMPANY CONSOLIDATED NET WORTH
